verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM docs reference 'Dynamic Model Selection' and community reviews confirm a wide range of provider/embedder choice including local and API-based LLMs, supporting multi-provider flexibility. However, no explicit evidence names Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and OpenRouter specifically, nor confirms per-agent/per-conversation model switching granularity in detail. Missing for 10: explicit named-provider list, documented per-agent/per-conversation model override UI, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching workflow.
